beats.title: Mycroft Phase 2
beats.narration: Hi, I am Dhrumil Shah, and this video is about how I extended Mycroft with a Phase 2 pipeline that stress-tests nine machine-learning models and three ensembles on 120 stocks, with purged walk-forward validation and market regimes.
beats.visual: Animated MYCROFT wordmark, subtitle, name card and five capability chips
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Up or down in 5 trading days?
beats.narration: Can daily price and volume data predict whether a stock rises over the next five trading days? The signal is tiny, so the real challenge is measuring it honestly.
beats.on_screen_title: Up or down in 5 trading days?
beats.visual: Three stacked cards: the question, the low-signal warning, the honest-measurement rule
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Built on Mycroft Phase 1
beats.narration: Phase 2 builds on Phase 1's 184,138 rows across 120 tickers. Phase 1's five review agents stay in place; Phase 2 focuses on the model layer beneath them.
beats.visual: Counting stat cards plus the Phase 1 five-agent chain
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: 18 new causal features
beats.narration: I added 18 new causal features, such as 60-day momentum, MACD, Bollinger position, ATR, distance to 52-week highs and lows, volume trends, and relative strength. The model now sees 44 features.
beats.visual: 18 feature chips in two columns, feature-count equation, MACD code panel
beats.animation: Chip cascade, amber callout bar on the macd line
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Market regime detector
beats.narration: A MarketRegimeDetector runs KMeans on market momentum and volatility, fitted on training dates only, to label each day bull or bear, with high or low volatility.
beats.visual: MarketRegimeDetector.fit() code panel and days-per-regime bars
beats.animation: Callout bar on the training-window lines, bars grow
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Purged walk-forward validation
beats.narration: Labels are purged and embargoed to block leakage. Four expanding walk-forward folds handle validation, and the final 27,600 rows, from March 2025, stay untouched as a holdout.
beats.visual: Walk-forward timeline (train / purge+embargo / validation / holdout), row-count cards, purge code
beats.animation: Fold bars extend along the date axis
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Nine models, one pipeline
beats.narration: Nine models compete: logistic regression, a linear SVM trained with SGD, Naive Bayes, LDA, KNN, AdaBoost, histogram gradient boosting, LightGBM, and XGBoost.
beats.visual: 3x3 model cards with real hyperparameters, linear_svm_sgd code panel
beats.animation: Cards pop in, callout on the SGDClassifier arguments
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Stability across folds
beats.narration: Across the folds, the linear SVM ranked first, at a mean ROC-AUC of 0.513. Every model sits near 0.5: this is a hard problem.
beats.visual: Mean walk-forward ROC-AUC bars, then notebook figure 02
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Three ensembles, no leakage
beats.narration: From out-of-fold predictions only, I built three ensembles: a soft vote, a skill-weighted average, and a stacked logistic-regression meta-learner.
beats.visual: Ensemble weight bars, three method cards, weighting code
beats.animation: Bars grow, cards stagger, callout on the weight formula
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: The untouched holdout
beats.narration: With selection fixed in advance, the linear SVM scored 0.521 on the holdout, with a 95% bootstrap interval of 0.510 to 0.533. Logistic regression reached 0.5335, but picked after the fact among twelve, it is optimistically biased.
beats.visual: 12-model leaderboard with bootstrap whiskers, crossfading to notebook figure 01
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Probabilities you can trust
beats.narration: Calibration cut the selected model's expected calibration error from about 0.037 to under 0.03, and the ROC, precision-recall, and reliability curves show the full picture.
beats.visual: Calibration-error bars, then figure 03 whole and panel by panel
beats.animation: Bars grow, panels crossfade with slow zoom
beats.transition_in: fade from background (0.35 s) with elements rising 50 px
beats.camera: locked 2160x3840 frame; movement is limited to slow Ken-Burns zooms on notebook figures

beats.title: Regime matters
beats.narration: Regime matters: in the bull, high-volatility regime, holdout ROC-AUC reached 0.62, but on only 720 observations. In the largest regime, bull and low volatility, it was 0.497, essentially random.
beats.visual: Figure 04 regime timeline above AUC-by-regime bars crossfading to figure 05

beats.title: Three more views
beats.narration: Three more views: new-feature correlations with the target, probability distributions by outcome, and consensus accuracy as the top models disagree.
beats.visual: Figures 06, 07 and 08 in sequence; figure 08 split into two stacked panels

beats.title: The honest verdict
beats.narration: The automated verdict: the confidence interval excludes 0.5, so there is weak but measurable ranking signal. Modest, but honest and reproducible.

beats.title: The Phase 2 workflow
beats.narration: Every model, metric, regime label, and figure is saved to disk, so the analysis can be audited and rerun.

beats.title: Evidence you can trust
beats.narration: This extension of Mycroft shows how feature engineering, rigorous validation, ensembles, and calibration turn raw market data into evidence you can trust, even when it is weak. I'm Dhrumil Shah. Thanks for watching.
